newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee rises vs dollar, breaches 35.80-mark.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee rises vs dollar, breaches 35.80-mark.

text.p: The Indian rupee broke through the 35.80 per dollar mark on Thursday afternoon as dollar demand tapered off amid good supplies, dealers said.
"Latest deals are at 35.7950," said a foreign bank dealer.
The rupee opened steady at 35.815/825 a dollar on Thursday.
The Reserve Bank of India did not buy dollars and the State Bank of India, the major dollar buyer in recent days, was bidding lower for dollars, dealers said.
The rupee gained against the forward dollar too.
November dollars were quoted at 0.81/0.84 rupees in the afternoon session compared to the opening level of 0.83/0.85 rupees, dealers said.
